description: Look up one domain name on PendingDelete.net's lists: its status (Redemption, Pending Delete, Released — checking, Available, Caught), when it drops (US Eastern) and whether that time is confirmed, length, registrar, registration date, Linking Domains, Rank, which of the same name's .com, .net and .org are registered, and its page. The lists hold names in redemption, in pending delete or released in the last 90 days; for any other name it says so and gives the page where a person can run a live registry lookup.
name: get_domain
